Also, the describe_query showed increasing trends in early warning signals (variance, autocorrelation, skewness, low-frequency power), which aligns with approaching a tipping point.

The last window prediction of 0.2519 is quite low, and p_critical of 0.3497 is the highest in the series (max is 0.3672). This strongly suggests the end of the series is close to tipping.

I should answer "alert".

Confidence: The last window p_critical is 0.3497, which is below 0.5 but notably elevated. The median prediction of 0.2519 is quite low. I'd say confidence around 0.7-0.75. Let me go with 0.72.
